content:
elaine (Finance): Heads-up: we're simplifying our free-credit model. Instead of per-minute buckets, we'll show a single monthly credit balance in invoices starting next billing cycle. No change in total value.

mohit (Billing Eng): Implementation: add new invoice line 'monthly_free_credit_balance' and a chart in the console. We'll keep per-minute telemetry internally for 90 days for rolling conversions.

cara (Product): Will customers see any interruption to rate limits?

elaine (Finance): No. Rate limits unchanged. This is purely billing presentation and an option to purchase a small one-off "surge pack" to avoid 429s during short spikes.

tim (Support): Draft support note: "We've consolidated free credits into a single monthly balance. If you'd like a temporary surge pack, you can purchase one from Billing Settings."

mohit (Billing Eng): Rollout: feature flag -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 7 days. We'll watch invoice generation latency and disputes count.

billing-bot: deploy started: billing-renderer:v2.3.7 -> canary 5%

elaine (Finance): Communication: blog post + KB article + console banner for 14 days prior. No TOS change required.

mohit (Billing Eng): deploy success: billing-renderer:v2.3.7 canary healthy (2026-03-23T19:02:11Z)

elaine (Finance): Thanks team — target ship next Wednesday.
